Tab.Label: Transform
Tab.Intro: Rotate the scene, add playable space around it or change its grid size. Tokens, walls, doors, lights, sounds, tiles, drawings, notes and regions move along, so everything stays where it belongs on the map. Changes are saved right away.

Pad.Hint: The scene grows by this many grid spaces on each side. Unlike Foundry's padding, players can move into the new space. Background and foreground images become locked tiles, so the map stays where it is.

Rotate.Hint: On a quarter turn, background and foreground images become locked tiles turned with the map. A half turn keeps them as backgrounds.

Grid.Hint: The size of one grid space in pixels. The map and everything on it grow or shrink with the grid, so the scene keeps the same number of grid spaces, for example 30 × 30 at 200 px becomes 30 × 30 at 100 px.

Options.BackupHint: Saves an untouched copy of the scene first, hidden from the navigation bar.
Options.ResetFogHint: Explored areas no longer match the map after a transformation.
